We expect recovery in 2H27after a weak June 2026 quarter.▪IOCL is amid a structural change, with~350kbpd of reﬁnery expansion capacity inplay.▪IOCL's well-positioned and large retailoutlet stations should be able to defendmarket share as competition intensiﬁes.▪IOCL's capex should incrementallydecrease and will remain focused on coreoperations.▪Among the fuel retailers, we prefer HPCL,followed by IOCL and BPCL to play theenergy security theme.

Fuel marketing: F2028e EV/EBITDA of 7.0x, in line with global comps for marketing peers.We believe in-line multiples are appropriate for a commodity business given EBITDA andEBITDA margin outlook, along with quality of debt and capex.BPCL's listed investments: 25% discount to market price, reﬂecting market volatility risks.

▪Beyond the shock, India will have a0.7mbpd increase in reﬁning capacity over2026-28, which will help net short reﬁnerslike BPCL.▪The US$9bn growth capex on downstreamchemical integration and new energy shouldsurprise positively on returns.

Capexintensity is poised to increase sequentially.▪We expect margins to start recoveringfrom F2H27 with tailwinds from increasedfuel realisations and reduced crude sourcingcosts.▪We OW on BPCL, but prefer HPCL andIOCL given the capex cycles and near-termstructural turnaround for HPCL and IOCL.
